_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE VC Method valuation -- a hypothetical $2M Series A check targeting a 40% IRR over a 5-year hold to a $200M exit, with 30% expected dilution from later financing rounds before that exit. Answers 'what ownership/valuation does this investor need today' -- the real, standard early-stage pricing technique (Sahlman, HBS), the mirror image of finmodel.cap_table's other functions (which take agreed round terms and compute the resulting cap table).
